_doc: AdSense config (Phase 1d). publisher_id: the pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX ID from the AdSense account; setting it adds the google-adsense-account tag on the home page and serves /ads.txt. approved: set true ONLY after Google approves the site; slots: the numeric ad unit IDs for each manual unit. Auto ads stay OFF in the AdSense account (POL-22). Every ad unit carries data-tag-for-age-treatment=1 (child-directed, POL-30). Bump content/launch.json purge after changing this file.
